reproduction.timing_script:
require 'json'
root = File.dirname(__FILE__)
runs = []
%w[point range index aggregate sort].each do |kind|
  count = kind == 'point' ? 1000000 : 50000
  expected = nil
  %w[before after after before].each_with_index do |stage, i|
    path = "#{root}/paired-#{kind}-#{i}-#{stage}.log"
    abort "benchmark #{stage} #{kind}" unless system("#{root}/#{stage}", count.to_s, kind, out: path, err: [:child, :out])
    lines = File.readlines(path)
    results = lines.grep(/^RESULT /)
    abort 'row or metadata mismatch' if expected && results != expected
    expected = results
    times = lines.grep(/^TIME /).map { |line| _, k, round, ns, n = line.split; {kind: k, round: round.to_i, ns: ns.to_i, count: n.to_i} }
    runs << {stage: stage, kind: kind, results: results, times: times}
  end
end
summary = {}
%w[point range index aggregate sort].each do |kind|
  grouped = %w[before after].map { |stage| runs.select { |r| r[:stage] == stage && r[:kind] == kind }.map { |r| r[:times].map { |t| t[:ns].to_f / t[:count] }.sort } }
  med = grouped.map { |g| a = g.flatten.sort; (a[4] + a[5]) / 2 }
  summary[kind] = {before_ns: med[0], after_ns: med[1], change_percent: (med[1] / med[0] - 1) * 100, per_run_medians: grouped.map { |g| g.map { |a| a[2] } }, values: grouped}
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate({runs: runs, summary: summary})

require 'json'
root = File.dirname(__FILE__)
topics = %w[table/index explain_easy explain_complex util/ranger index_join index_merge executor/aggregate session/clustered_index executor/prepared expression/charset_and_collation common_collation collation_pointget subquery planner/core/join_reorder_through_projection executor/update executor/delete expression/constant_fold expression/builtin expression/cast expression/plan_cache agg_predicate_pushdown]
stage, binary = ARGV
normalize = ->(text) { text.gsub(/in\s+\d+ms/, 'in TIME').gsub(/finished in [0-9.]+s/, 'finished in TIME') }
topics.each do |topic|
  path = "#{root}/#{stage}-#{topic.tr('/', '_')}.log"
  abort topic unless system({'INTEGRATION_TOPIC' => topic, 'INTEGRATION_SHOW_DIVERGENCES' => '1'}, binary, '--ignored', '--nocapture', 'replay_one_topic_from_env', '--test-threads=12', out: path, err: [:child, :out])
  if stage == 'after'
    before = normalize.call(File.read(path.sub('/after-', '/before-')))
    after = normalize.call(File.read(path))
    unless before == after
      old = before.lines
      new = after.lines
      differences = old.zip(new).each_with_index.filter_map { |(a, b), n| {line: n + 1, before: a&.slice(0, 300), after: b&.slice(0, 300)} if a != b }
      puts JSON.generate({topic: topic, differences: differences.take(10), before_lines: old.length, after_lines: new.length})
      abort "different #{topic}"
    end
    puts "IDENTICAL #{topic}"
  end
end
